central_idea_and_construction: Exactly OFFCUT in one line as an approachable paper-play wordmark. Draw compact, soft, slightly irregular uppercase letters with voluptuous curves and distinctly open white counters. The O is slightly tipped left, F letters are round-ended with generous notches, C is broad and open, the U sits a little lower as a bowl, the T opens its arms. Give the name a gentle rising-and-falling rhythm without touching or losing the baseline reading. Flat solid color and an edited hand-cut-paper feel without jagged cut edges or texture. The whole name fills 80% of the width at center. No separate symbol or confetti.
color_roles: raspberry accent on the U only
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Open O/C/U counters and gently bouncing single-line lettering.
specific_risk: Inflation or over-tight spacing can erase F/F and C/U distinctions.
reference_transfer: Negative user screenshots analyzed as text: avoid severed slabs and nested squared Ls; no positive visual reference or borrowed signature.
observations: Recorded separately after viewing actual output.
